detail.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery
detail.summary: Autonomous open-ended discovery benefits from integrating intrinsic curiosity mechanisms—which bootstrap learning in deceptive or unrewarding environments—with long-running multi-agent frameworks that enable persistent memory, tool interaction, and collaborative search.
detail.reason: Updating notebook nb-autonomous-inquiry-001 to incorporate newly retrieved foundational evidence on curiosity-driven learning progress alongside empirical multi-agent discovery architectures.
